title: I can pray to jesus
lyrics_original: I can pray to jesus a Friend who always answers
I may be very small. but He answers when I call
That's why I love you Jesus forever we will be friends
Eya eya eyaya – eya eya eyaya....

bible_verses.english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
If you ask anything in my name, I will do it.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being a faithful friend who always listens when I call. Even when I feel small or insignificant, You welcome me into Your presence with open arms. Help me to bring all my joys and worries to You in prayer every day. Thank You for loving me and inviting me to walk with You forever. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being a faithful friend who always listens when I call. Even when I feel small or insignificant, You welcome me into Your presence with open arms. Help me to bring all my joys and worries to You in prayer every day. Thank You for loving me and inviting me to walk with You forever. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: No matter how small or weak we might feel, Jesus invites us into a deep, tender friendship with Him. He is never too busy to listen, and His heart is always open to our prayers. When we bring our simple thoughts, worries, and praises to Him, we experience the joy of being fully known and deeply loved. Let us come to Him today with open hearts, trusting that our loving Savior hears every word we pray.
